name: AppImageKit runtime, x86_64
why_this_release: `continuous` is what appimagetool itself uses and the only runtime AppImageKit still publishes binaries for; the newest TAGGED release with an asset is 12 (2019-05-01). continuous is mutable by definition, so the pin is the sha256 plus the publish date -- the build verifies the hash and says which one it used. Nothing in the payload depends on this file beyond appending it.
why_a_pin_at_all: Before this, the runtime was carved out of whichever .AppImage happened to be on the build machine, which meant the deliverable contained an unversioned binary of unknown origin, and a rebuild was only possible on that one machine.
